features.title: Print a phone sign-in QR for a trusted HTTPS origin
features.summary: At startup the Host runs a loopback rewrite proxy so a TLS-terminating tunnel (Tailscale Serve) can reach the native listener without a trustedHosts setting, detects the tailnet hostname, points Serve at that proxy, and prints one scannable sign-in QR. Configured https origins skip detection.
failureModes: A non-HTTPS, credentialed, or non-absolute origin is ignored instead of printed.
A busy proxy port is reported on the terminal and leaves the rest of DSH running.
Missing Tailscale, or Serve failing to start, prints no auto-detected QR and never guesses an origin.
